listing_info.listing_name: The Cabin at Alton Bay
listing_info.description:
There's plenty of space for everyone in this newly renovated 4-bedroom, 3-bath log cabin tucked away on 10 wooded acres with beautiful private views. Easy access to year-round NH Lakes Region activities: hiking & snowmobile trails at the end of the driveway; 2 min from Lake Winnipesaukee public boat launch; 3 mi from Mt. Major hiking; 15 min from Gunstock Mountain skiing & summer fun; 20 min from Bank of NH Pavilion. Family & pet-friendly, and the 1st floor is entirely step-free.

The space
1st floor: step-free ramp access to mudroom/sunroom | mountain lodge-like living/dining area with plenty of seating and a gas fireplace, 65" Samsung Smart TV, and lots of games | fully-stocked kitchen with brand-new cabinets, countertops, and appliances | 2 cozy bedrooms (each with a queen memory foam log bed) | full bathroom with accessible shower

2nd floor: open loft with sitting/reading area and many books to share | primary bedroom suite with a queen memory foam log bed, dedicated office space (with very reliable wifi and an extra computer monitor), & a full bathroom

Basement: family room with power reclining sectional sofa, bar-table seating, 65" Samsung Smart TV, foosball table, and infrared sauna | bedroom with a full log bed, a twin log bed, and 2 pop-up twin trundle beds | full bathroom and laundry

Other: whole-house water filtration system (so all taps produce purified water) | whole-house generator | portable AC units in bedrooms and a mini-split unit in the main living area

Outdoors: covered front porch and large wrap-around deck with gas grill | (seasonal) outdoor furniture and propane fire pit | pond and babbling brook | flat private yard for games and play | (seasonal) kayaks/paddle boards x 6 (with advanced permission) | plenty of parking and space for trailers/toys | beautiful wooded 10 acres (and if you’re quiet, glimpses of the animals that live there)

Guest access
Guests have access to the entire home with the exception of the locked utility room and storage areas.

Other things to note
- There are way too many amenities to list, so please don't hesitate to reach out to inquire about any specific requests or questions, especially if you will be traveling with children, pets, and/or those with mobility issues.
- We strive to be a toxin-free home. We also provide diffusers with essential oils for your enjoyment.

listing_info.listing_name: “Stay Awhile in the Lake's Region”
listing_info.description:
This gorgeous property features 3 bedrooms- 1 King bed in the master suite, 1 queen bed and 2 twin beds, perfect for a family or group of friends looking for a cozy retreat. With 2 bathrooms, including a soaking bathtub, you can unwind in style after a day of exploring. The rec room offers an additional sleeping space with a queen bed. Space for parking a boat to use in the best lake in New Hampshire! Conveniently located off of route 28 for easy access to all areas in the Lakes Region.

The space
Welcome to our romantic, yet family friendly, centrally located cottage. The home is 1350 sf which does not include the 1000 sft game room. Comfortably sleeps up to 7 with a roll out for an 8th person.
We have a family or “grown-up kid”game room with ping pong, fooseball, air hockey, small basketball net and board games for all ages. There are also comfortable seating spots for everyone to just hang out. . There are 2 Roku t.v.s with high speed internet. There is also a large blue tooth speaker. The electric fireplaces add heat and ambiance . Set up for a perfect gathering place for family and friends to reconnect as there is lots of space to spread out. There are 2 decks off the kitchen with tables and seating as well as a bbq grill. A full walk out basement to a private back yard area. There is a fire pit to use in the front yard with more seating.
Our space is a great home base for many year round activities. We are 20 minutes from Gunstock Mountain Resort which boasts breathtaking views, hiking, skiing snowshoeing, cross country and exploring.
The cottage is 1/2 mile up the street from Lake Winnipesaukee, town beach, public docks, boat ramp, restaurants, and ice cream.
Mt Major is about 17 minutes away.
If hiking is your thing, hosts will share our favorite spots to whoever is interested in exploring.

Wolfboro, “Americas Oldest Summer Resort” is 15 minutes away, which offers a quaint downtown for dining and shopping.

In Wolfboro there is also the Cotton Valley Rail trail for biking. Excellent walking trails also off of the bike trail.

Kayaks can be available to use if you have a vehicle to get them down to the beach. (Seasonally)

Guests will discover a plethora of fun activities to do all within a half an hour from home base.

Hannaford grocery store is 1 mile from the cottage.

Weirs Beach Laconia, home to the infamous “Motorcycle Week” is less than 30 minutes

There are many fun things to do in this wonderful area we call home. Come visit and please stay awhile!

Guest access
All the decks and the backyard area. Guests can also have a small fire in the fire pit outside. Wind and weather permitting.

Other things to note
Kayaks are available upon request and to be used safely at your own risk. We provide the life jackets for you. Please be safe when using them!

listing_info.listing_name: Fall Foliage views from the mountains Alton Bay NH
listing_info.description:
Welcome to Alton Mountain lodge with unsurpassed views of Lake Winnipesaukee! This house provides the new modern rustic charm of lake living with all the modern conveniences you’ll need for your getaway in Alton Bay, NH. Enjoy beautiful views of the lake, mountains and spectacular sunrises, and sunsets. The Straightback Mountain top home has 3 bedrooms and 2 bathrooms. Open kitchen/living room, with a family room/game room. Make some memories at this unique and family-friendly place.

The space
The house is located in Alton Bay on Alton Mountain, which provides unique view but requires climbing stairs to access the house. The house is similar to a raised ranch with the main living area on the 2nd floor. The basement is partially finished with a bed room, recreation/TV room that also has a futon bed, sectional and TV. On the main floor (2nd level), you'll find 2 more bedrooms, the master has a private bathroom and incredible lake views and the second features a shared bathroom and walkout to the back deck, large open family room with incredible views, dining area, 2 bathrooms (1 with a shower, 1 with a tub) and a fully stocked kitchen.

Guest access
Guests will have access to the full house excluding some closets, mechanical rooms, garage, and shed.

Other things to note
We must mention that this house has stairs to access the living spaces. The access to the front door is up a full flight of stairs. The driveway is uphill as well. The property offers flat spaces for out door activities including a fire pit in the back yard. No smoking of any kind on this property.

Additionally, we visit with our pets. Please consider this fact if you have allergies to dogs.

We do not allow guests to bring pets (ours are territorial and will mark once you leave). Apologies. We understand how hard leaving a pet behind is.

listing_info.description:
Come build memories at this beautiful lake front house with its own dedicated deep water slip (across the street), a large deck on the water with diving board, and another deck attached to the house. A sandy public beach , restaurants, and Mt Washington boat stop are only steps away. This well-kept house has an open concept, fully applianced modern kitchen, a 55" smart 4K Roku TV, 1 gig fiber internet/wi-fi, a jacuzzi in one of the bathrooms, grill*, all the comforts of home, and so much more.

The space
This house is right on Lake Winnipesaukee (across the street but nothing other than the street is in your way). The slip that is included in the rental will give you access to the entire lake which is 71 mi² (area) and 20.75 mi (length).

Guest access
-The whole house.
-The dock on Lake Winni is shared with the guests staying in the guest house.
-Public beach steps away.

Other things to note
-**Ask about weekday specials from November-March** (Sun-Thu night & non-holiday weeks)
-The only address I’m providing to avoid complications is the one that brings you to the driveway, which is the back of the house: 14 Mariette Dr, Alton Bay (next door to 17 Mariette Dr). There is parking for three cars in the driveways directly behind the house (there is absolutely no other overnight parking, and only public parking on other streets during the day).
-The people staying in the cottage next door will most likely walk through the side of the yard & down the front steps to get to the dock, as that will save them about about 5-10 minutes (we hope this is not an issue for anyone). The people renting the two slips from us may also pass through while you are staying at the house.
-The street our house is on is windy, and we have a mirror on the deck that shows if cars are coming from the left so you can get a better view. Most people are fine with this, but I don't think you would want little kids crossing alone.
-New ductless heating and air conditioning installed throughout the house.
-We have a Keurig.
-There are two grills left outside seasonally - one electric next to the house, and one gas/propane (to the left of the cottage next door and is shared with them). If you want to use it before/after the summer months, please give us a week's notice (or less if we are up there), and we'll leave it out for you.

listing_info.listing_name: Modern Lakefront Escape | Kayaks, Dock, Fire Pit
listing_info.description:
Welcome to our family friendly waterfront home on Merrymeeting Lake! Enjoy the serenity and beauty of this deep and crystal clear spring fed lake, and make memories with family and friends that last a lifetime. Take in spectacular panoramic views of the lush green mountains across the lake from any of the large windows throughout the house, on the covered deck, or from several of the outdoor vantage points in the back yard, terrace, or dock. Instant relaxation unlocked!

The space
The home offers modern amenities and gorgeous views of this crystal clear lake and mountains. There are 2 bedrooms each with queen beds on the first floor, and a third bedroom with a queen bed and a twin bunk bed on the basement level. There is a full bathroom on the first floor and a half bath on the basement level.

The kitchen is well equipped with most of the things you’d find in your own kitchen such as a blender for frozen drinks and an electric griddle for pancakes. A new Weber propane grill is available as well. There is a dining table in the kitchen area, as well as an outdoor dining table seating six on the covered deck to enjoy meals while taking in the view and enjoying the cool lake breeze.

The walk out basement to the backyard and fire pit includes an entertainment area with large screen smart enabled TV and seating for seven, as well as a half bathroom. The basement floor also has a separate bedroom with queen bed and bunk beds, as well as a comfy couch for lounging.

High end Pottery Barn furnishings fill most of the home. The home is professionally cleaned and laundered.

There is a long modern aluminum deep-water dock with stair access into the water as well as ladder access. We also have a floating swim dock that everyone will enjoy. A lower level terrace with loungers and chairs lies at the water’s edge beckoning you to relax. Two kayaks and two stand up paddle boards are conveniently located down by the docks and available for your enjoyment. There is an assortment of PFDs for you to use while boating.

Bring your boat and dock it! Boats up to 26 feet are welcome.

High speed Wi-Fi internet is available on site. You'll never be more than a few steps away from your favorite lakeside activities!

The home is conveniently located only an hour from the I-95 MA/NH border. It’s located a 20 minutes from Wolfeboro/Lake Winnipesaukee. The wonderful Merrymeeting Marina with ice cream shop is a half mile away and is easily walked. A state run boat launch is located a half mile from the property. Multiple trails are present around the lake for hiking or walking, and the White Mountains are a short easy drive north.

NH Meals and Rentals Tax Operator’s License No. 105945

Guest access
You are welcome to use the whole house aside from the owner’s closet and outdoor shed.

listing_info.listing_name: Vintage Pine Cottage on Merrymeeting Lake
listing_info.description:
Three season 3bdrm lake front cottage on Merrymeeting Lake. Sleeps 6. Built
in 1953, this rustic family camp is our summer treasure we are sharing with you. You'll be charmed by the history as we've kept the vintage feel.

The space
You'll find a full kitchen with just about everything you need; stove, refrigerator, microwave, coffee maker, pots and pans. There are even spices and random condiments that you are welcome to use if needed. Eat breakfast at the 2 barstool kitchen island between the open concept kitchen and living room area. The living room has a full couch and 2 vintage accent chairs , and a gorgeous old Franklin wood burning stove.
Enjoy the view. Sit and have dinner on the screened in covered porch while you watch the sunset and listen to the loons. You might just get lucky and spot a bald eagle.
Each of the 3 bedrooms has a chest of drawers for your belongings, where you'll also find extra sheets and bath towels stored. Bedroom 1 has a full size bed, and views of both front and back of the cabin. Let the loons sing you to sleep. The red wooden crate contains board games.
Bedroom 2 has 2 single beds and faces the water front.
Bedroom 3 has a bunk bed set up with 2 single beds. You'll find a collection of board games and puzzles in one of the sets of drawers in this room for kid friendly fun.
The only full sized bathroom is located between the 2 smaller bedrooms. You will find towels, soap, shampoo, conditioner and a first aid kit in the medicine cabinet.
